messages.text: BL-1729 🎵 in progress — The property lane dies on the V8 per-worker heap cap on the shared main checkout (BL-1651's crash signature back: two FATAL heap deaths then ERR_IPC_CHANNEL_CLOSED, 5 of 5 main refusals, 0 in any worktree), so every extension/src commit on main is refused unless the guard is overridden: bl874PortableTimeInvariants and tempDirTrapGuard walk the whole repository root through the shared tolerant walk, which skips .worktrees/ but not the gitignored .swarmforge/, and read its 475 MB of bundled .js (the operator's VS Code CLI servers) into one worker (894 MB and 1778 MB alone on main); the walk never opens the root's runtime directories
